text: Hallelujah (Praise the LORD)! Praise the LORD {YHWH}, O my soul.
I will praise the LORD {YHWH} all my life; I will sing praises to my God {Elohay} while I have my being.
Put not your⁺ trust in princes, in mortal man, who cannot save.
When his spirit {ruachow} departs, he returns to the ground; on that very day his plans perish.
Blessed is he whose help is the God of Jacob (he grasps the heel), whose hope is in the LORD his God {YHWH Elohaw},
the Maker of heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them. He remains faithful forever.
He executes justice for the oppressed and gives food to the hungry. The LORD {YHWH} sets the prisoners free,
the LORD {YHWH} opens the eyes of the blind, the LORD lifts those who are weighed down, the LORD loves the righteous.
The LORD {YHWH} protects foreigners; He sustains the fatherless and the widow, but the ways of the wicked He frustrates.
The LORD {YHWH} reigns forever, your God {Eloheka}, O Zion, for all generations. Hallelujah!
